Hills and tides unite under the silver light of a pristine new moon. Temporarily transforms the surrounding terrain into Lunar DomainLunar DomainThe domain that Columbina summons after unleashing the Elemental Burst Moonlit Melancholy.
When current active characters are within the Lunar Domain, Lunar Reaction DMG inflicted by all party members will increase., dealing AoE Hydro DMG.

In ancient times, people called the three messengers connecting the material world and the universe "Iynx," which means bird-like gods.

Moonlit Melancholy is Columbina's Elemental Burst.

Gameplay Notes[]

Constellation Effects
  • Constellation Level 5, Silence Tending One Lone Song: Increases this talent's level by 3, up to a maximum of 15.
  • Constellation Level 6, Through Darkness Led by Moonlight: "For 8s after characters in the Lunar DomainLunar Domain The domain that Columbina summons after unleashing the Elemental Burst Moonlit Melancholy. When current active characters are within the Lunar Domain, Lunar Reaction DMG inflicted by all party members will increase. trigger a Lunar reaction, based on the elements involved in the reaction, the CRIT DMG of the corresponding Elemental DMG done by all party members is increased by 80%. The CRIT DMG-increasing effects for the same Elemental Type do not stack. All nearby party members' Lunar Reaction DMG is elevatedElevationSpecial DMG Boost effect. It is calculated independently of other DMG Boost effects. by 7%."
